dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Pronounced concave curvature of the trailing edge, fitting a high-order spline from the rounded apex to the posterior insertion point on the dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a small pixel radius, forming the terminal vertex between a straight leading edge and a falcate trailing edge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Linear anterior margin with a steepness of approximately 50-55 degrees relative to the horizontal axis of the visible peduncle segment.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.25:1, calculated as the horizontal pixel span from the anterior to posterior insertion points relative to the maximum vertical height from the ridge to the apex.
